title: kbgit.py sync routes code-lane paths to a code/<id> branch even when backlog.json sets lane_module to empty
goal: With lane_module "" in backlog.json, kg_lane.lane_plan treats every commit as content, as bl_base, bl_land and kb/_self/backlog.md say an empty value means (review of SP-5y4ut64g, found by ST-dj4bgo4s's worker).

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
here = os.getcwd()
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", T, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
try:
    g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("config", "user.email", "a@example.com"); g("config", "user.name", "a")
    cfg = json.load(open(os.path.join(here, "backlog.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    cfg["lane_module"] = ""
    json.dump(cfg, open(os.path.join(T, "backlog.json"), "w"))
    g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base")
    up = g("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "_tools")); open(os.path.join(T, "_tools", "x.py"), "w").write("X = 1\n")
    g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "feat: x", "-m", "KB-Work: ST-aaaaaaaa")
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(here, "_tools"))
    import kg_lane, kblane
    lane, branch = kg_lane.lane_plan(T, up, "HEAD")
    assert lane == kblane.CONTENT and branch is None, ("lane_module empty but routed", lane, branch)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
